messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month really depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowd levels, or price—but most travelers find that late spring (April–June) and early fall (September–November) offer the sweet spot.

| Season | Typical Weather | Crowds | Price |
|--------|-----------------|--------|-------|
| **Late Spring (Apr‑Jun)** | Warm, sunny days; sea temperatures around 78–80 °F (26–27 °C). Rainfall starts to pick up in June but usually only brief showers. | Moderate – still lower than peak summer. | Mid‑range – higher than winter lows but lower than July/August peaks. |
| **Summer (Jul‑Aug)** | Hotest period; highs 86–90 °F (30–32 °C), humidity rises. Sea temps warmest (~82–84 °F / 28–29 °C). | Highest – families on school holidays, many events. | Peak prices for flights & hotels. |
| **Early Fall (Sep‑Nov)** | Still warm; highs 83–88 °F (28–31 °C); rainfall increases toward November but remains manageable. | Low – post‑summer lull, especially after Labor Day. | Lower than summer, but still above winter lows. |
| **Winter (Dec‑Feb)** | Cooler, especially at night; highs 70–75 °F (21–24 °C). Chance of rain higher, especially on the windward side. | Lowest – great deals, but some beaches may feel cooler. | Best deals on accommodation and airfare. |

**Bottom line:** If you want pleasant beach weather without the biggest crowds or highest prices, aim for **late May or early October**. Those months tend to have sunny skies, comfortable temperatures, and more reasonable rates. If you’re okay with higher prices and don’t mind larger crowds, mid‑July offers the hottest water and plenty of festivals. Conversely, if budget is your top priority and you don’t mind slightly cooler evenings, December–January can be very affordable.
